paragraphs.source_en: The musician may sing to you of the rhythm which is in all space, but he cannot give you the ear which arrests the rhythm nor the voice that echoes it. And he who is versed in the science of numbers can tell of the regions of weight and measure, but he cannot conduct you thither.

paragraphs.source_en: For without words, in friendship, all thoughts, all desires, all expectations are born and shared, with joy that is unacclaimed.
